22: # Image Edit — Pro Pack on RunComfy
23: 
24: [runcomfy.com](https://www.runcomfy.com/?utm_source=skills.sh&utm_medium=skill&utm_campaign=image-edit) · [Nano Banana Edit](https://www.runcomfy.com/models/google/nano-banana-2/edit?utm_source=skills.sh&utm_medium=skill&utm_campaign=image-edit) · [GPT Image 2 Edit](https://www.runcomfy.com/models/openai/gpt-image-2/edit?utm_source=skills.sh&utm_medium=skill&utm_campaign=image-edit) · [Flux Kontext](https://www.runcomfy.com/models/blackforestlabs/flux-1-kontext-pro/image-to-image?utm_source=skills.sh&utm_medium=skill&utm_campaign=image-edit) · [Z-Image Inpaint](https://www.runcomfy.com/models/tongyi-mai/z-image/turbo/inpainting?utm_source=skills.sh&utm_medium=skill&utm_campaign=image-edit) · [GitHub](https://github.com/agentspace-so/runcomfy-skills/tree/main/image-edit)
25: 
26: **Image edit, intent-routed.** This skill doesn't lock you to one model — it picks the right edit model in the RunComfy catalog based on what the user actually wants: batch identity-preservation, multilingual text rewrite, single-shot precise edit, or mask-driven region replacement.
27: 
28: ```bash
29: npx skills add agentspace-so/runcomfy-skills --skill image-edit -g
30: ```
31: 
32: ## Pick the right model for the user's intent
33: 
34: | User intent | Model | Why |
35: |---|---|---|
36: | Batch edit 1–20 images consistently (SKU gallery, A/B variants) | **Nano Banana Edit** | Up to 20 input images per call; locked aspect/resolution for series |
37: | Swap background, preserve subject identity | **Nano Banana Edit** | Strong identity preservation under "keep X unchanged" prompts |
38: | Localized object removal / addition with spatial language ("the left object", "upper-right corner") | **Nano Banana Edit** | Honors directional spatial scope |
39: | Multilingual / non-Latin in-image text rewrite (Japanese kana, Cyrillic, Arabic) | **GPT Image 2 Edit** | Strongest in class for multilingual typography |
40: | Multi-reference composition (subject from img1, scene from img2, palette from img3) | **GPT Image 2 Edit** | Numbered refs route cues correctly |
41: | Layout-precise repositioning ("move headline from top-right to bottom-center") | **GPT Image 2 Edit** | Directional language honored at layout level |
42: | Identity preservation across translated headline variants | **GPT Image 2 Edit** | Same source asset → many language variants, identity stable |
43: | Single-shot precise local edit ("she's now holding an orange umbrella") | **Flux Kontext Pro** | Single-ref single-instruction, high-fidelity preservation |
44: | Mask-driven object removal (cables, watermarks, distractions) | **Z-Image Turbo Inpaint** | Mask-required, strength-tunable, edge-consistent |
45: | Mask-driven region replacement (full background swap with mask) | **Z-Image Turbo Inpaint** | High strength + clean mask = clean replacement |
46: | Default if unspecified | **Nano Banana Edit** | Most flexible, supports both single and batch |
47: 
48: The agent reads this table, classifies the user's intent, and picks the matching subsection below.
49: 
50: ## Prerequisites
51: 
52: 1. **RunComfy CLI** — `npm i -g @runcomfy/cli`
53: 2. **RunComfy account** — `runcomfy login`.
54: 3. **CI / containers** — set `RUNCOMFY_TOKEN=<token>`.
55: 
56: ---
57: 
58: ## Route 1: Nano Banana Edit — default for general edit + batch
59: 
60: **Model**: `google/nano-banana-2/edit`
61: 
62: ### Schema
63: 
64: | Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
65: |---|---|---|---|---|
66: | `prompt` | string | yes | — | Lead with preservation goals, end with the change. |
67: | `image_urls` | array | yes | — | **1–20** publicly-fetchable HTTPS URLs. |
68: | `number_of_images` | int | no | 1 | 1–4 outputs per call. |
69: | `aspect_ratio` | enum | no | `auto` | `auto` follows input; lock for batch consistency. |
70: | `resolution` | enum | no | `1K` | `0.5K` / `1K` / `2K` / `4K`. |
71: | `output_format` | enum | no | `png` | `png` / `jpeg` / `webp`. |
72: | `seed` | int | no | — | Reproducibility. |
73: | `enable_web_search` | bool | no | false | Web-grounded edits (extra latency). |
74: 
75: ### Invoke
76: 
77: ```bash
78: runcomfy run google/nano-banana-2/edit \
79:   --input '{
80:     "prompt": "Keep the subject identity, pose, and clothing unchanged. Convert the background into a rainy neon cyberpunk street.",
81:     "image_urls": ["https://.../portrait.jpg"]
82:   }' \
83:   --output-dir <absolute/path>
84: ```
85: 
86: **Batch (lock aspect + resolution):**
87: 
88: ```bash
89: runcomfy run google/nano-banana-2/edit \
90:   --input '{
91:     "prompt": "Replace the watermark in the bottom-right with the text \"AURA\" in clean white sans-serif. Keep everything else exactly as in the input.",
92:     "image_urls": ["https://.../sku-1.jpg", "https://.../sku-2.jpg", "https://.../sku-3.jpg"],
93:     "aspect_ratio": "1:1",
94:     "resolution": "1K"
95:   }' \
96:   --output-dir <absolute/path>
97: ```
98: 
99: ### Prompting tips
100: 
101: - **Preservation first**: `"Keep [identity / pose / brand / framing] unchanged."` Then state the change.
102: - **Spatial scope**: "background only", "the left object", "upper-right quadrant" — concrete locations honored.
103: - **Batch consistency**: lock `aspect_ratio` and `resolution` across the batch.
104: - **Iterate small**: split compound edits into multiple shorter passes.
105: 
106: ---
107: 
108: ## Route 2: GPT Image 2 Edit — multilingual text + multi-ref composition
109: 
110: **Model**: `openai/gpt-image-2/edit`
111: 
112: ### Schema
113: 
114: | Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
115: |---|---|---|---|---|
116: | `prompt` | string | yes | — | Edit instruction; lead with preservation. |
117: | `images` | string[] | yes | — | **Up to 10** HTTPS URLs. First is primary; rest are auxiliary. |
118: | `size` | enum | no | `auto` | `auto`, `1024_1024`, `1024_1536`, `1536_1024`. **Only these.** |
119: 
120: ### Invoke
121: 
122: **Multilingual text rewrite:**
123: 
124: ```bash
125: runcomfy run openai/gpt-image-2/edit \
126:   --input '{
127:     "prompt": "Keep the photograph, layout, and brand mark exactly as in the input. Replace only the in-image headline. The new headline reads \"今日のおすすめ\" in bold Japanese kana, same position and font weight.",
128:     "images": ["https://.../poster-en.jpg"]
129:   }' \
130:   --output-dir <absolute/path>
131: ```
132: 
133: **Multi-ref composition:**
134: 
135: ```bash
136: runcomfy run openai/gpt-image-2/edit \
137:   --input '{
138:     "prompt": "Compose subject from image 1 into the room from image 2. Match the lighting and color palette of image 2. Keep image 1 subject identity unchanged.",
139:     "images": ["https://.../subject.jpg", "https://.../room.jpg"]
140:   }' \
141:   --output-dir <absolute/path>
142: ```
143: 
144: ### Prompting tips
145: 
146: - **Quote in-image text exactly.** Name the script for non-Latin: `"Japanese kana"`, `"Cyrillic"`, `"Arabic right-to-left"`.
147: - **Number multi-refs**: `"subject from image 1, lighting from image 2"`.
148: - **Directional layout language**: `"move the headline from top-right to bottom-center"`, `"replace the watermark in the bottom-right"`.
149: - **`size: "auto"`** preserves input ratio — recommended unless the edit changes framing.
150: 
151: ---
152: 
153: ## Route 3: Flux Kontext Pro — single-shot precise local edit
154: 
155: **Model**: `blackforestlabs/flux-1-kontext/pro/edit`
156: 
157: ### Schema (minimal)
158: 
159: | Field | Type | Required | Notes |
160: |---|---|---|---|
161: | `prompt` | string | yes | One declarative edit instruction. |
162: | `image` | string | yes | **Single** source image URL. |
163: | `aspect_ratio` | enum | no | Pick from supported W:H values. |
164: | `seed` | int | no | Reproducibility. |
165: 
166: Single image only — no array. For multi-image flows, use Route 1 (Nano Banana Edit).
167: 
168: ### Invoke
169: 
170: ```bash
171: runcomfy run blackforestlabs/flux-1-kontext/pro/edit \
172:   --input '{
173:     "prompt": "Keep the person'\''s face, pose, and clothing unchanged. Add an orange umbrella in her left hand and a slight smile.",
174:     "image": "https://.../portrait.jpg"
175:   }' \
176:   --output-dir <absolute/path>
177: ```
178: 
179: ### Prompting tips
180: 
181: - **One declarative instruction.** "She is now holding an orange umbrella and smiling" — imperative, single change.
182: - **Preservation first.** Lead with `"Keep [unchanged elements]"` then state the change.
183: - **Iterate small.** Compound edits drift on a single pass; split into sequential passes.
184: 
185: ---

187: ## Route 4: Z-Image Turbo Inpaint — mask-driven precise region edit
188: 
189: **Model**: `tongyi-mai/z-image/turbo/inpainting`
190: 
191: ### Schema
192: 
193: | Field | Type | Required | Notes |
194: |---|---|---|---|
195: | `prompt` | string | yes | What to fill / replace; preservation constraints for the unmasked surround. |
196: | `image` | string | yes | Source image URL. |
197: | `mask_image` | string | yes | **Grayscale mask URL** (white = inpaint, black = preserve). |
198: | `strength` | float | no | 0.3–0.6 retouching, 0.7–1.0 full replacement. |
199: | `control_scale` | float | no | 0.6–0.9 typical. |
200: | `aspect_ratio` | enum | no | W:H output ratio. |
201: | `seed` | int | no | Reproducibility. |
202: 
203: ### Invoke
204: 
205: **Object removal (low strength):**
206: 
207: ```bash
208: runcomfy run tongyi-mai/z-image/turbo/inpainting \
209:   --input '{
210:     "prompt": "Remove overhead cables; preserve rooflines and sky gradient; thin clean sky.",
211:     "image": "https://.../street.jpg",
212:     "mask_image": "https://.../cables-mask.png",
213:     "strength": 0.5,
214:     "control_scale": 0.8
215:   }' \
216:   --output-dir <absolute/path>
217: ```
218: 
219: **Region replacement (high strength):**
220: 
221: ```bash
222: runcomfy run tongyi-mai/z-image/turbo/inpainting \
223:   --input '{
224:     "prompt": "Replace busy backdrop with smooth light gray studio paper; mask background only.",
225:     "image": "https://.../product.jpg",
226:     "mask_image": "https://.../bg-mask.png",
227:     "strength": 0.9
228:   }' \
229:   --output-dir <absolute/path>
230: ```
231: 
232: ### Prompting tips
233: 
234: - **A mask URL is required** — grayscale, white = inpaint region, black = preserve. Slight blur on mask edges (1–3px) blends better than sharp binary.
235: - **Strength by intent**: `0.3–0.5` for retouching / cleanup, `0.6–0.7` for object replacement with style match, `0.8–1.0` for full-region replacement.
236: - **Name what stays outside the mask** in the prompt: `"preserve rooflines and sky gradient"`, `"match brick pattern and mortar tone"`.
237: - **Spatial labels still help** even though the mask defines the region: `"the left shelf"`, `"upper-right quadrant"`.
238:

240: 
241: ## Limitations
242: 
243: - **Each route inherits its model's limits.** Nano Banana: 1–20 inputs, 1–4 outputs. GPT Image 2 Edit: up to 10 refs, 4 fixed sizes. Flux Kontext: single ref. Z-Image Inpaint: mask required.
244: - **No multi-route blending.** This skill picks one model per call.
245: - **Brand-specific overrides** — if the user named a specific model, route to the corresponding brand skill (`gpt-image-edit`, `flux-kontext`, `nano-banana-edit`) for fuller treatment.

260: ## How it works
261: 
262: The skill picks one of Nano Banana Edit / GPT Image 2 Edit / Flux Kontext Pro / Z-Image Turbo Inpaint based on user intent and invokes `runcomfy run <model_id>` with the matching JSON body. The CLI POSTs to the Model API, polls the request, fetches the result, and downloads any `.runcomfy.net`/`.runcomfy.com` URL into `--output-dir`. `Ctrl-C` cancels the remote request before exit.
263: 
264: ## Security & Privacy
265: 
266: - **Token storage**: `runcomfy login` writes the API token to `~/.config/runcomfy/token.json` with mode 0600 (owner-only read/write). Set `RUNCOMFY_TOKEN` env var to bypass the file entirely in CI / containers.
267: - **Input boundary**: the user prompt is passed as a JSON string to the CLI via `--input`. The CLI does NOT shell-expand the prompt; it transmits the JSON body directly to the Model API over HTTPS. No shell injection surface from prompt content.

269: - **Outbound endpoints**: only `model-api.runcomfy.net` (request submission) and `*.runcomfy.net` / `*.runcomfy.com` (download whitelist for generated outputs). No telemetry, no callbacks.
